name: Repo City
tagline: This app: a WebXR city on your desk built from a code repo, where a failing test sets a building on fire.

source.note: Built from this project's own src/**/*.ts at the time `npm run city` last ran.

districts.name: City
districts.summary: Reads a city JSON file and builds the miniature city: districts, buildings, floors and streets.

districts.name: FX
districts.summary: Visual effects such as the fire on a building with a failing test.

districts.summary: Hand tracking: pinching, poking and grabbing the city with bare hands.

districts.name: MR
districts.summary: Mixed reality: finding the real table and placing the city on it.

districts.name: UI
districts.summary: Panels and labels drawn in the headset: the guide, code cards and test results.

districts.summary: The app entry: creates the IWSDK world, registers systems and wires the pieces together.
